<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — All 20 literals at console.css:42, 90, 92, 132, 255 (both values), 378, 431, 568, 580, 982, 1228, 1276, 1322, 1581, 1607, 1756, 2225, 2277 and 2470 are replaced with var() tokens. No other console.css declaration changed.
- A2: met — The 11 new tokens are each defined once in :root with matching values: #3a434d, #f3c27a, #ffffff, 10px, 36px, 2px, 3px, 10px, 18px, 9px, 10px. The diff adds nothing to the dark block.
- A3: unverified — Screenshot proof is produced by the prove step and is not part of the diff. The swaps are value-identical, so no visual change is expected.
- A4: met — Colour tokens are in the chrome and surfaces tables, --t-10 and --t-36 are in the size scale, the spacing tokens are in a spacing sub-table, and the radii are in the radius table. All console.css Observation rows are removed and the auth.css rows are kept.
- A5: unverified — The axe run is part of the prove step and is not visible in the diff.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- --c-tip-warn sits in the chrome group `src/app/globals.css:19` — Optionally move it beside the other chart and tooltip colours, or leave it with a matching DESIGN.md role note (already present).
- Observations could note --c-paper and --c-pane share a light value `DESIGN.md` — Add one sentence to 'Same value, separate tokens' explaining that --c-paper stays #ffffff in dark while --c-pane does not.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: --c-tip-warn sits in the chrome group
suggestions.detail: The token is only used for tooltip text (.viz-tip-out), but it is declared under the '/* chrome (top bar) */' group. DESIGN.md also lists it in the chrome table. The tooltip background is --c-chrome, so the grouping is defensible, but someone scanning :root for tooltip colours may not look there.
suggestions.fix: Optionally move it beside the other chart and tooltip colours, or leave it with a matching DESIGN.md role note (already present).

suggestions.title: Observations could note --c-paper and --c-pane share a light value
suggestions.detail: The 'Same value, separate tokens' observation lists other duplicates (--page-max/--wrap). --c-paper and --c-pane are both #ffffff in light and differ only because --c-pane has a dark override. A note there would explain why both exist.
suggestions.fix: Add one sentence to 'Same value, separate tokens' explaining that --c-paper stays #ffffff in dark while --c-pane does not.
